mapper.select:
SELECT r.id AS id, r.tab_type AS tabType, r.rule_name AS ruleName, r.rule_desc AS `desc`, r.status AS status, DATE_FORMAT(r.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(r.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate, DATE_FORMAT(r.data_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dataStartDate, DATE_FORMAT(r.data_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dataEndDate, r.create_by AS createBy, DATE_FORMAT(r.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_sr_warning_hit h WHERE h.rule_id = r.id AND h.is_deleted = 0) AS hitCount, r.channels AS channelsStr, r.strategies AS strategiesStr, r.logic AS logic FROM t_sr_warning_rule r
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.id AS id, r.tab_type AS tabType, r.rule_name AS ruleName, r.rule_desc AS `desc`, r.status AS status, DATE_FORMAT(r.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(r.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate, DATE_FORMAT(r.data_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dataStartDate, DATE_FORMAT(r.data_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dataEndDate, r.create_by AS createBy, DATE_FORMAT(r.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, r.channels AS channelsStr, r.strategies AS strategiesStr, r.logic AS logic FROM t_sr_warning_rule r WHERE r.tab_type = #{tabType} AND r.is_deleted = 0
AND r.id= #{ruleId}
AND r.status = '生效中' AND r.end_date < CURDATE()
AND r.status = #{status}
AND r.end_date >= CURDATE()
AND LOCATE(#{pageScopeMarker}, COALESCE(r.rule_desc, '')) > 0
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.id AS id, r.tab_type AS tabType, r.rule_name AS ruleName, r.rule_desc AS `desc`, r.status AS status, DATE_FORMAT(r.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(r.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate, DATE_FORMAT(r.data_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dataStartDate, DATE_FORMAT(r.data_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dataEndDate, r.create_by AS createBy, DATE_FORMAT(r.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_sr_warning_hit h WHERE h.rule_id = r.id AND h.is_deleted = 0) AS hitCount, r.channels AS channelsStr, r.strategies AS strategiesStr, r.logic AS logic FROM t_sr_warning_rule r WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT c.metric_code AS metricCode, c.metric_name AS metricName, c.operator AS operator, c.threshold AS threshold, c.unit AS unit, c.sort_no AS sortNo FROM t_sr_warning_rule_condition c WHERE c.rule_id = #{ruleId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.sort_no, c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_sr_warning_rule (rule_name, rule_desc, tab_type, status, start_date, end_date, data_start_date,data_end_date, channels, strategies, logic, create_by, creator, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{ruleName}, #{ruleDesc}, #{tabType}, #{status}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{dataStartDate}, #{dataEndDate}, #{channels}, #{strategies}, #{logic}, #{createBy}, #{creator}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE t_sr_warning_rule SET rule_name = #{ruleName}, rule_desc = #{ruleDesc}, status = #{status}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, data_start_date = #{dataStartDate}, data_end_date = #{dataEndDate}, channels = #{channels}, strategies = #{strategies}, logic = #{logic}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE t_sr_warning_rule SET status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_sr_warning_rule_condition (rule_id, metric_code, metric_name, operator, threshold, unit, sort_no, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{ruleId}, #{metricCode}, #{metricName}, #{operator}, #{threshold}, #{unit}, #{sortNo}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE t_sr_warning_rule_condition SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE rule_id = #{ruleId} AND is_deleted = 0

choose.when:
SELECT s.strategy_id AS strategyId, s.strategy_code AS strategyCode, s.strategy_name AS strategyName, s.channel AS channel, COALESCE(d.key_name, s.channel) AS channelName, s.big_category AS bigCategory, s.small_category AS smallCategory, s.push_count AS consultCount, s.push_count_qoq AS consultCountQoQ, s.usage_count AS retainCount, s.usage_count_qoq AS retainCountQoQ, s.usage_rate AS retainRate, s.usage_rate_qoq AS retainRateQoQ, s.reach_count AS dispatchCount, s.reach_count_qoq AS dispatchCountQoQ, s.product_conv_num AS successCount, s.product_conv_num_qoq AS successCountQoQ, s.product_conv_rate AS successRate, s.product_conv_rate_qoq AS successRateQoQ, s.actual_income AS income, s.actual_income_qoq AS incomeQoQ, DATE_FORMAT(s.stat_month, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statMonth FROM t_sr_strategy_period_summary_ctrl s LEFT JOIN t_sr_dim_channel d ON d.key_code = s.channel
and s.channel!='全部' and s.big_category !='全部' and s.small_category !='全部' and s.strategy_name!='全部' ${conditionSQL} ORDER BY s.product_conv_num DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

and s.channel!='全部' and s.big_category !='全部' and s.small_category !='全部' and s.strategy_name!='全部' ${conditionSQL} ORDER BY s.product_conv_num DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
